Sprint 14 — Deep UI/UX overhaul to transform InkOS from dull prototype to polished modern SaaS. Working dir: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`. **The audit found these core problems making the UI dull:** 1. Most cards have NO shadows — UI is flat/2D 2. Zero hover transitions — no feedback on interaction 3. "Sprint X" placeholder text on 7+ pages — looks unfinished 4. Electric purple (#7c3aed) brand color barely used — generic feel 5. Empty states use gray muted icons — no brand personality 6. No micro-interactions or animations on page load 7. Typography is flat — only 2 heading sizes 8. Sidebar/header lack elevation — blend into content **Execute ALL phases. This is visual polish — touch CSS, components, page files. Do NOT change API routes or database.** ### PHASE 1 — Remove ALL "Sprint X" stubs Grep entire `app/` directory for "Sprint" text in page files. Replace EVERY instance: ```bash grep -rn "Sprint " app/ --include="*.tsx" | grep -v node_modules | grep -v .next ``` Known locations to fix: - Any page that says "Sprint X" → replace with proper empty state using `EmptyState` component OR real "Coming soon" card with icon + description - Replace placeholder descriptions like "Sprint 4 will wire..." with actual feature description or remove - Every settings sub-page that's a stub → replace with a proper "Feature coming soon" card: icon (purple bg), title, description, no "Sprint" mention ### PHASE 2 — Global Design System (touch these files) **A. `app/globals.css`** — Add at the bottom of `@layer base`: ```css /* Global interaction transitions */ button, [role="button"], a, [data-slot="button"] { transition-property: color, background-color, border-color, box-shadow, transform; transition-duration: 150ms; transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } /* Card hover utility */ .card-interactive { transition: box-shadow 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .card-interactive:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft-md); border-color: oklch(var(--primary) / 0.2); } /* Stagger animation helper */ .stagger-fade-in > * { opacity: 0; animation: fade-in-up 0.4s ease forwards; } .stagger-fade-in > *:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0ms; } .stagger-fade-in > *:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 50ms; } .stagger-fade-in > *:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 100ms; } .stagger-fade-in > *:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 150ms; } .stagger-fade-in > *:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 200ms; } .stagger-fade-in > *:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 250ms; } ``` Also increase the auth page glow: find `opacity-[0.07]` in auth layout → change to `opacity-[0.15]`. **B. `components/ui/card.tsx`** — Add default shadow + hover transition to Card component: - Add `shadow-[var(--shadow-card)]` to Card's className - Keep the existing ring border **C. `components/ui/button.tsx`** — The base button class already has `transition-all` (we added it). Add `active:scale-[0.98]` to the base cva class string for press feedback. **D. `components/shared/EmptyState.tsx`** — Upgrade: - Icon wrapper: `bg-muted/50` → `bg-primary/10` - Icon color: `text-muted-foreground/40` → `text-primary/70` - CTA button: if variant="outline", change to variant="default" (purple primary button is more inviting) **E. `components/shared/KpiCard.tsx`** (or whatever the dashboard stat card is called) — Upgrade: - Add `border-l-2 border-primary` for purple left accent - Icon: increase size to `h-5 w-5`, color `text-primary` - Value text: ensure `text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums` - Add `card-interactive` class for hover effect **F. `components/shared/PageHeader.tsx`** — Upgrade: - Title: `text-xl` → `text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight` - Add subtle purple gradient underline or left accent bar - Subtitle: `text-muted-foreground` with slightly larger size ### PHASE 3 — Sidebar & Header Polish **G. `components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar.tsx`** — Upgrade: - Active nav item: add `border-l-2 border-primary bg-primary/10` for clear active indicator - Section headers: add `text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-muted-foreground/60 font-semibold` - Nav item text: slightly larger, better spacing - Studio logo area: add subtle purple glow or border-b with accent **H. `components/app/sidebar/AppHeader.tsx`** — Upgrade: - Add `border-b border-border shadow-sm` for elevation separation - Background: solid `bg-background` not transparent/blur - Breadcrumb current page: `font-medium text-foreground` (not muted) ### PHASE 4 — Auth Pages **I. `app/(auth)/layout.tsx`** — Upgrade: - Background glow: `opacity-[0.07]` → `opacity-[0.15]` (more visible purple) - Add tagline below the InkOS logo: "The OS for Modern Ink Studios" in `text-sm text-muted-foreground` **J. `components/auth/LoginForm.tsx`** + `SignupForm.tsx`: - Input focus ring: ensure it uses `focus-visible:ring-primary/40` (purple tint) - Error states: red border + shake animation (`animate-shake` — add keyframe if missing) - "or continue with" divider text: slightly more visible ### PHASE 5 — Dashboard Polish **K. `app/(app)/dashboard/DashboardClient.tsx`** — Upgrade: - Greeting: `text-xl` → `text-3xl font-bold` with studio name in `text-primary` - KPI card grid: add `stagger-fade-in` class to the grid container - Schedule timeline card: add shadow + proper card styling - Activity feed: add shadow + card styling - Alerts card: add shadow + proper card border ### PHASE 6 — Page-by-Page Content Fixes For EVERY page that currently shows placeholder content, add a proper "Coming soon" or empty state card. Pattern: ```tsx

Feature Name

Brief description of what this feature does when fully connected.

``` Pages to fix (check each): - `/settings` (studio profile) - `/settings/policies` (booking policies) - `/payments` (payment history) - `/appointments/new` (new appointment flow) - `/artists/schedules` (schedule overview) - `/clients/new` (new client) - `/waitlist` - Any others that show "Sprint X" or stub text ### PHASE 7 — List Page Empty States For every major list page, ensure the `EmptyState` component is used with proper copy when data is empty: - `/appointments` → "No appointments scheduled yet" + Calendar icon + "Book your first appointment" CTA - `/clients` → "No clients yet" + Users icon + "Add your first client" CTA - `/artists` → "No artists in your studio" + Palette icon + "Create your artist profile" CTA - `/consent-forms` → "No consent forms" + FileText icon + "Create your first template" CTA - `/inventory` → "Track your studio supplies" + Package icon + "Add first item" CTA - `/commissions` → "Commission tracking starts after your first completed booking" + DollarSign icon - `/payroll` → "Run your first payroll after approving commissions" + Banknote icon - `/guest-artists` → "No guest artist engagements" + UserPlus icon + "Create engagement" CTA - `/waitlist` → "No one on the waitlist" + Clock icon - `/locations` → "Your studio has one location" + MapPin icon + "Add location" CTA ### PHASE 8 — Dark Theme Sweep Grep for any hardcoded light colors in components: ```bash grep -rn "bg-white\|text-black\|text-gray-\|bg-gray-\|border-gray-" app/ components/ --include="*.tsx" ``` Replace all with semantic tokens: `bg-card`, `text-foreground`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`. ### PHASE 9 — Final Gate ```bash pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test ``` Git commit with descriptive message. **Hard rules:** - Zero `any`, zero `console.log` - Do NOT change any API routes, database queries, or business logic - Only touch CSS, components, and page files - base-nova `render` not `asChild` - All changes must be dark-mode compatible - No raw hex colors — use CSS variables / Tailwind tokens only - Every change should make the app look MORE premium, not just different **Deliverables:** 1. All 4 gates green 2. Count of files modified 3. List of all "Sprint X" references removed 4. Summary of visual changes per component
